verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਆਸਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g tiragun ateet cheet aasaa mai niraas hai ||

en.bdb: An obedient disciple of the True Guru lodges the Guru's word in his consciousness in the holy company of God-loving people. He protects his mind from the influence of maya (mammon) and remains free from the worldly options and conceptions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਰਤੈ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam nihakaam dhaam sahaj subhai ridhai baratai baratamaan giaan ko pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Living and dealing with the world, the Naam of the Lord which is treasure-house of indifference to the worldly attractions gets lodged in his mind. Thus the divine light effulges in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sookham sathool ek ek aau anek mek braham bibek Tek braham bisavaiaas hai ||

en.bdb: The Supreme Lord who manifests in perceptible and subtle ways in everything of the world becomes his support when he contemplates on Him. He reposes his confidence in that Lord alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋੁਇ ਰੇਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran liv aapaa khoi huoi ren satigur sat gurmat gur dhaas hai ||190||

en.bdb: By engrossing and attaching the mind in the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru, one destroys his egocentricity and adopts humility. He lives in the service of holy men and becomes a true servant of the Guru by accepting the teachings of the True Guru. (190)
